messages:
Ivy (new-hire): hey team, hitting an odd Postgres init error when running `docker compose up` for the first time: `initdb: invalid locale settings; check that LC_COLLATE and LC_CTYPE are valid`

Ivy (new-hire): full stack excerpt:
```
Postgres  | initdb: invalid locale settings
Postgres  | DETAIL:  Value "en_US.UTF-8" for locale category LC_COLLATE is not supported.
Postgres  | HINT:  Make sure that the locales are installed on the system.
```

Marta: welcome Ivy :wave: this usually happens when the image or the host (for bind mounts) doesn't have the locale generated. Are you using a custom postgres build or a slim image like `postgres:15-slim`?

Ivy (new-hire): using our Dockerfile that starts from `debian:bookworm-slim` and installs postgresql. I think the container doesn't have locale-gen installed.

Ben (infra): yep two quick fixes: 1) install locales and generate en_US.UTF-8 in the image, or 2) tell initdb to use the C locale (less ideal for sorting but works). Example for Dockerfile (install locales):
```
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y locales \
 && sed -i '/en_US.UTF-8/s/^# //g' /etc/locale.gen \
 && locale-gen en_US.UTF-8 \
 && update-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8
```
That way initdb finds the locale and succeeds.

Marta: alternative fast workaround (no image change) is to pass initdb args via compose env: `POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--locale=C"` which forces the C locale and avoids needing to install locales. Add under the postgres service in `docker-compose.override.yml` for dev.

Ivy (new-hire): tried the POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS with `--locale=C` and `docker compose down && mv ./pgdata ./pgdata-bak && docker compose up -d` and postgres initialized. migrations ran. Thanks!

Nora (docs): good catch  can you open a docs PR describing both fixes (install locales in the dev image and the initdb-c fallback) plus the host-bind gotcha requiring reinit when PGDATA changes? New hires will hit this.

Ben (infra): small note: if you switch the image to include locales, remember to remove or reinitialize the host pgdata (named volume vs bind). Also on mac the locale generation tends to be fine in full images but slim variants often omit locales.

Ivy (new-hire): will open the PR with the Dockerfile snippet and the compose fallback. Appreciate the help! :rocket:

infra-bot: Welcome Ivy! You were added to #new-hires. Ping @Ben or @Marta for infra help. :robot_face:
